run_simulate_grating: run simulate_grating to compute TE and TM polarized reflection from a 1D stripe grating
run_permittivity_tensor_elements_anisotr: run permittivity_tensor_elements_anisotropic to get the permittivity tensor elements of an anisotropic material
run_grating_density: run grating_density to compute the density array for a grating with given pitch and width
refactor_simulate_grating: refactor simulate_grating to support custom wavelength arrays and grating geometry parameters
review_simulate_grating: review simulate_grating to understand how FMM eigensolve and scattering matrix are used for grating simulation
